name: clawd

sheet.role: the design's authority: full-body front, 3/4, profile and back, four expression heads, hands; the sheet the 2D rig was built from

scale.method: its front figure's height against the rig's (the same drawing at a known scale)

cautions: low resolution (a head is about 115 px per head length): eye-spacing scale is +-4%, use the figure height

rig.role: the front design at high resolution, cut into layers: eye layers (the eyes' shape, iris, pupil), the face layer, hair layers

scale.method: eye layers' spacing = 2 * eye_x head lengths

cautions: the face layer is bled out under the hair (about 15 px): its bottom is not the chin; take the chin from the sheet

key3d.role: a 3D-style restyle of the design (front, full body): the TRELLIS input and the ref_iou silhouette
cautions: an interpretation of the design, not the design: its face is rounder and fuller than the sheet's

trellis.role: the 3D target: the hair's shape, the face's depth where the drawings have none, the silhouette per band

provenance.note: the command is reconstructed from the output's name and the run's settings, not logged at the time

cautions: 48 MB, kept out of git: regenerate with the command, or copy it into charkit/out/i3d/clawd/

outfit_graph.role: the outfit as pieces: types, sides and mirror pairs, attachments (bone, parent), layer order, colours, extents per sheet view and in 3D, motion classes with reasons, template mapping and spring chains
cautions: measured from the rig, the sheet and the generated field, cross-checked with the annotated vision pass (outfit_notes.json): read its flags before trusting a piece

head_turnaround.role: the head at about 4x the sheet's resolution: front, 3/4 (left), true profile (left), back at one scale; the profile shows the eye set back, the pointed nose, lips, chin and jaw
cautions: a generated interpretation of the design: check it against the sheet (silhouettes and landmarks at the sheet's scale) before letting it grade anything

head_construction.role: the bald head with construction lines (skull top, brow, eye line, nose, mouth, chin), front and profile: the skull and the face shape under the hair, the ear, the eye's set-back in profile; also the eye close-up: its front eye is ~1.6x the rig's eye layer and measures the same with charkit.eyeqa (opening aspect 0.922 vs 0.925, iris ratio 0.59 vs 0.61, pupil share of the iris 0.067 vs 0.071)
cautions: a generated interpretation: its front chin is more pointed than the sheet's; trust it for the profile and the skull, check the front against the sheet

garment_breakdown.role: the outfit as a labelled flat-lay of its pieces: bodice front and back, puff sleeves, sailor collar, bow with tails, outer skirt, cream front panel, stepped back panels L/R, shorts, wrist cuffs, boots front and back
cautions: flat-lay scale is not body scale: use it for piece shapes, counts (pleats, hem steps) and the piece list, not for sizes on the body

hair_breakdown.role: the hair as colour-coded layers in front, profile and back (bangs, side locks, upper and lower back, buns, ahoge, flyaways) with a legend: a machine-readable layer map for the hair components
cautions: layer families are reliable; individual locks within a family are only partly separated (close shades)

sleeve_closeup.role: the puff sleeve's construction on a mannequin arm, front, outer side and back: the gathered sleeve cap at the armhole, the balloon volume, the gathers into the cream band above the elbow; a cross-section at the widest point (how far the fabric stands off the arm all round); the wrist cuff front and side with its stepped notch
cautions: the mannequin is generic, not Clawd's body: use it for the sleeve's shape, gathers and stand-off relative to the arm, and take the puff's size on the body from the sheet

skirt_closeup.role: the layered skirt's construction on a mannequin, front, side profile and back, plus a top-down view of the panel order round the waist: the knife-pleated orange outer skirt, the pleated cream front panel set into it, and the longer stepped zig-zag under-panels at the sides and back; the side view gives the hem flare and the longer back
cautions: the mannequin is generic: take the skirt's length and flare on the body from the sheet

the top-down view is schematic: it puts stepped edging on every outer panel, where the back view shows a plain outer hem over stepped under-panels; use it for panel order and count, check the hem against the sheet's views

body_turnaround.role: the full body for 3D modelling in one generation: front, three-quarter (turned to the viewer's left), true side profile (facing left) and back, one A-pose, one scale, one ground line and eye line, the complete outfit; the base for the body and hair silhouettes, the outfit's placement and the palette (Michael, 2026-09-28: idol_D is the source design, not a benchmark)
cautions: the arms hang about 20-25 degrees out from vertical, not the 45 asked for: the rest-pose knobs fit it
check it against the head sheets (charkit refcheck) before it grades anything

notes: 2026-09-28: four generated references added (gen/). The authority map is unchanged until each is checked against the sheet; candidates: face_profile and skull -> head_construction / head_turnaround, garment piece shapes -> garment_breakdown, hair layers -> hair_breakdown.
